facts.business: Raymond Limited is a leading Indian fashion and lifestyle company with leadership positions in branded textiles, apparel, and garmenting, operating brands such as Park Avenue, ColorPlus, and Ethnix by Raymond, while also having a presence in precision engineering and aerospace through its subsidiaries.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on demerger of real estate business undertaking to Raymond Realty Limited effective 01 May 2025, with fair value of H 6,64,136 lakhs debited to retained earnings and gain on demerger of H 5,32,645 lakhs recognised as exceptional item.

key_risks: Impairment risk in investment and receivables from joint venture Raymond UCO Denim Private Limited
Contingent liabilities related to past divested businesses (Cement, Steel, Denim divisions)
Legal claims on tenancy rights over land at Thane
Disputed tax demands (Sales tax, Royalty, Stamp duty, Excise/custom duty)
facts.related_party_note: The Company has outstanding loans of H 2,500 lakhs, interest receivable of H 63 lakhs, and other receivables of H 860 lakhs from Raymond UCO Denim Private Limited (joint venture) as at 31 March 2026. Deemed equity investments in subsidiaries JK Files & Engineering Limited, JK Maini Precision Technology Limited, and JK Maini Global Aerospace Limited.
